environment: Isolated Node VM, simulated media APIs and independent ZXing decoder. No physical phone camera or live organization.

results.name: new customer drafts and vendor POs receive distinct stable barcode values
generated labels resolve exact records and reject the other PO type
barcode stays stable when a PO reference changes
ambiguous human references and scanned URLs never pick an arbitrary order
wrong item does not mutate stock, counters, audit or revision
blank, missing and PO barcodes cannot pass an item scan
correct item updates its pick progress and wave without consuming stock
camera request replay counts exactly once
request IDs cannot be reused for another quantity
over-picking and non-integer quantities are rejected atomically
stale workspace revisions cannot post a scan
valid UPC/EAN/GTIN leading-zero forms identify the same item
SKU punctuation is not fuzzy-matched
barcode collisions across products fail instead of passing a wrong item
saved item codes preserve zeros and prevent cross-item reassignment
unvalidated and hold orders cannot be picked
all order lines must pass before picking or shipping can finish
finishing picking is idempotent and stock is consumed only at dispatch
legacy complete-wave button cannot bypass a barcode-verified order
vendor wrong-item and excess receipts do not change balances
vendor scans save receiving counts while keeping inventory pending
vendor repeated request cannot double-count a delivery
partial receipts and later deliveries post inventory exactly once
receiving with duplicate SKU lines is aggregated without losing units
putaway must have a valid bin and sufficient capacity
bulk receiving cannot bypass an active scanned batch
finished receiving prevents rescanning until its putaway completes
scanning counters survive a workspace reload
distributed Code128 encoder is decoded independently by ZXing
camera requests video only after explicit start and prefers rear-facing
fallback decoder counts only one frame until explicitly rearmed
camera cancellation during permission prompt releases late streams
camera permission rejection gives a useful fallback message
camera without HTTPS fails before requesting device access
camera stop removes preview stream and ignores late barcode callbacks
failed fallback decoder setup releases the camera
torch is applied only on a supporting active camera
